summary: Field Notes is a multi-author blog. Visitors see a home page listing posts newest first, a page for each post that shows its author, and a page for each author listing that author's posts.
targetUsers: Readers looking for recent posts from several writers
Authors who publish posts under their own name
goals: Show all posts on the home page ordered newest first
Give every post its own page that names its author
Give every author a page listing that author's posts
nonGoals: Editing or publishing posts from the site itself

features.name: Home post list
features.userOutcome: A visitor sees every post on the home page, newest first.
features.trigger: A visitor opens the site's home page.
features.behavior: The home page lists every post with its title, author name, and publication date, ordered by publication date with the newest post first. Each entry links to that post's page and to that author's page.
features.failureOutcome: The build fails when a post content file is missing its title, author, or publication date.
acceptanceSignals: The built home page lists every post from the content files.
The first post listed on the home page has the latest publication date of all posts.
Each listed post shows its title, author name, and publication date.

features.name: Post page
features.userOutcome: A visitor reads one post on its own page and sees who wrote it.
features.trigger: A visitor follows a link to a post from the home page or an author page.
features.behavior: Each post has its own page showing the post title, its full body text, its publication date, and the name of its author. The author name links to that author's page.
features.failureOutcome: The build fails when a post content file is missing its title, author, or body text.
acceptanceSignals: A page exists for every post in the content files.
Each post page shows the post title, body text, publication date, and author name.
The author name on a post page links to that author's page.

features.name: Author page
features.userOutcome: A visitor sees one author's page listing that author's posts.
features.trigger: A visitor follows a link to an author from the home page or a post page.
features.behavior: Each author has a page showing the author's name and a list of that author's posts, newest first, each linking to its post page. Posts by other authors are not listed.
features.failureOutcome: The build fails when a post references an author that is not defined in the content files.
acceptanceSignals: A page exists for every author in the content files.
An author page lists exactly the posts whose author is that author.
The posts on an author page are ordered newest first.

dataObjects.name: Posts
dataObjects.purpose: The blog posts, each with its title, body text, publication date, and author.
dataObjects.retentionIntent: Kept as site content and rebuilt into pages on every build.

dataObjects.name: Authors
dataObjects.purpose: The blog's authors, each with a name and a short biography.
dataObjects.retentionIntent: Kept as site content and rebuilt into pages on every build.

qualityRequirements: The home page lists posts in descending publication date order.
Every post page and author page is reachable by a link from the home page.
productConstraints: The site is static: pages are built once from content files.
An address that matches no page shows the site's 404 page.
